Data source: "Standardised inflows of permanent-type migrants" by OECD (Last updated: November 03, 2025)

```{r}
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

d <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/OECD.ELS.IMD,DSD_MIG_INT@DF_MIG_INT_PER,1.0,complete,2026-10-17 15-19-58.csv"
)

unique(d$`Reference area`)
```


```{r}
d_summarised <- d |>
  group_by(
    area = recode(
      `Reference area`,
      "Belgium" = "ベルギー",
      "Czechia" = "チェコ",
      "Estonia" = "エストニア",
      "Finland" = "フィンランド",
      "France" = "フランス",
      "Germany" = "ドイツ",
      "Israel" = "イスラエル",
      "Italy" = "イタリア",
      "Lithuania" = "リトアニア",
      "Luxembourg" = "ルクセンブルク",
      "Mexico" = "メキシコ",
      "Netherlands" = "オランダ",
      "Norway" = "ノルウェー",
      "Portugal" = "ポルトガル",
      "Slovak Republic" = "スロバキア",
      "Slovenia" = "スロベニア",
      "Spain" = "スペイン",
      "Switzerland" = "スイス",
      "Ireland" = "アイルランド",
      "Sweden" = "スウェーデン",
      "New Zealand" = "ニュージーランド",
      "Canada" = "カナダ",
      "Japan" = "日本",
      "Korea" = "韓国",
      "United Kingdom" = "イギリス",
      "United States" = "アメリカ",
      "Australia" = "オーストラリア",
      "Denmark" = "デンマーク",
      "Austria" = "オーストラリア"
    ),
    year = TIME_PERIOD,
    type = fct_recode(
      `Entry category`,
      "自由移動" = "Free movements",
      "労働" = "Work",
      "帯同家族" = "Accompanying family of workers",
      "家族" = "Family",
      "人道" = "Humanitarian",
      "その他" = "Other",
    )
  ) |>
  summarise(n = sum(OBS_VALUE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## Number of Migrants

```{r}
d_by_country <- d_summarised |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .by = c(area, year)) |>
  mutate(area = fct_reorder(area, n, .desc = TRUE))

ggplot(d_by_country, aes(year, n, colour = area)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  gghighlight::gghighlight(
    area %in%
      c(
        "アメリカ",
        "ドイツ",
        "カナダ",
        "イギリス",
        "スペイン",
        "オーストラリア",
        "フランス",
        "韓国",
        "日本"
      ),
    line_label_type = "sec_axis"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

## Migration Reasons

```{r}
d_pct <- d_summarised |>
  filter(
    area %in%
      c(
        "アメリカ",
        "ドイツ",
        "イギリス",
        "カナダ",
        "韓国",
        "日本"
      )
  ) |>
  mutate(`%` = n / sum(n), .by = c(area, year))

ggplot(d_pct, aes(type, `%`, colour = year, group = factor(year))) +
  geom_polygon(fill = NA) +
  see::coord_radar(clip = "off") +
  facet_wrap(vars(area)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_colour_continuous(breaks = 2013:2024) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 4, unit = "pt")),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, angle = -45, hjust = 0),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.1, "npc"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.015, "npc"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "npc"),
  )
```
